Keywords: Chełmno town land and judicial privileges
RagShortTexts: Chełmno law frames town landholding and judicial arrangements.
Urban privileges coexist with obligations to rulers and the Order.

Variants.Content: A town under Chełmno law uses granted rights for land, revenue and justice. Beneficiaries need the limits and attached obligations. Civic participation coexists with negotiation with lord or Order, and a charter still requires implementation.
Town guards need defined watch and gate duties. Possessing weapons grants no free judicial authority; officers must identify the authority behind enforcement.
Privileges attract settlers and trade while conceding local responsibilities. Arbitrarily changing dues damages confidence in the grant and weakens future revenue.
Residents need recognized holdings and ways to resolve debt, alongside agreed duties. Disputes require witnesses and applicable terms, not simply a claim to urban freedom.
